bio: In a charming fishing village, this cosy restaurant brings the sea right to your plate... and just steps away from your table! The real gem is the veranda overlooking the water: once seated, you are lulled by the sound of the waves and enchanted by a picture-postcard view. The patron, Stiven Vunić, devotes himself with great skill to seafood cuisine in which the very fresh and fragrant product is the real star. The recipes are simple but refined: sometimes a modern twist appears, but more often the focus is on the reassuring comfort of well-executed tradition. Raw dishes, pastas, catch of the day, shellfish and crustaceans served by weight make up an offering that faithfully follows the season and local market availability, so don't be surprised if some dishes are not available.
